shots.beat: Central Station platform: people waiting in the rain; a train's light swells up the track.
shots.characters: Jun Park (transit operator), three civilians on the platform, Kai (foreground left)
shots.lighting: Warm platform canopy light, the yellow edge strip, the stopped station clock.
shots.sound: Train horn (the game's 311 / 370 Hz pair), rising rail hiss.
shots.notes: The mission freezes ~2.2 s after Kai crosses z -104 (action at t 0.3): cut out on the frame before the freeze.

preview.note: Kai left, the train headlight swells at the end; cut before the freeze.

shots.beat: The Zero Second: low in the train's path, the derailing train hangs tilted in the air above the camera, its sparks frozen around it as points of light; a slow push up toward its nose.
shots.lighting: The freeze grade (desaturated, cold); sparks as hanging points of light; rain as beads.
shots.sound: Hard cut into one second of total silence (bible: the Zero Second), then a low metallic resonance.
shots.notes: Camera on the track bed in the train's path, pushing 2 m toward the nose (linear: no ease at the cut points). Focus held on the nose so the frozen sparks between camera and train fall into soft points. The nose lamps / spot are toned down at run time (glow 8 -> 3, spot 60 -> 20): at full strength their bloom flooded the left half of the frame. The passing ambient train is hidden (it shares the track).

preview.note: Derailing train hangs with frozen sparks in the freeze grade.

shots.beat: Kai walks alone through the frozen station toward us, the derailed train hanging behind him: he passes a frozen Jun, glances at him, then looks straight at us. The only thing still moving.
shots.characters: Kai (tracking side-on), frozen commuters and umbrellas between camera and Kai
shots.lighting: Frozen rain beads catch the station light; Kai the only warm, moving figure.
shots.sound: Kai's footsteps, glass-harmonic shimmer of the held rain.
shots.notes: Leading Steadicam: the camera is anchored to Kai and backs away as he walks, closing from a full figure (27 deg) to a knees-up mid shot (31 deg). Kai walks at 1.26 m/s on the touch stick (setStick 0.3) so the 'walk' clip plays, not the jog. He glances at the frozen Jun as he passes (t 1.6) and finds the lens at t 3.7, under the VO line. Dialogue rig on Kai.

preview.note: Kai walks through the held station in the freeze grade.

shots.beat: In the crowd at the Helix doors, a woman with Mira's face looks straight at Kai (at us), framed in the doors' cyan light; then she comes apart into violet light and is gone, and the focus finds the empty Helix doors.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game;const spots=[[-4.38,-101,[-6.6,-131.5,2.4]],[-5.89,-112,[0.4,-133.5,-0.9]],[3.23,-124,[2.4,-129.8,-2.0]]];let n=0;for(const o of g.scene.children){const c=o.userData.character;if(!c)continue;for(const [x,z,to] of spots){if(Math.abs(o.position.x-x)<0.6&&Math.abs(o.position.z-z)<0.6){o.position.set(to[0],0.15,to[1]);o.rotation.y=to[2];n++;}}}return 'crowd behind her: '+n})()

shots.characters: Mira (close-up, looking at Kai), crowd behind
shots.lighting: Helix entrance glow behind her; her violet dissolve (the mission's ghost shader).
shots.sound: The three-note motif (E-B-A) on felt piano; Kai: "...Mira?"
shots.notes: Slow push along her eyeline (Kai stands just behind the camera, so she looks into the lens). She is revealed 1 s before the mission does it: solid from the cut-in to ~2.9 s, dissolving ~2.9-4.3 s, gone by 4.3 s; the focus racks to the Helix doors at 4.35-4.95 s. EDIT: put Kai's '...Mira?' at shot t ~2.5 (edit ~29.75 s), just before she dissolves. Ghost material made front-faced at run time (the mission's double-sided additive ghost shows a skull-like mask). Three idle commuters moved behind her as a soft crowd; env probe re-captured at the camera (it was taken by the crash fire).

preview.note: She is solid at the cut-in, violet at the middle, gone at the cut-out. Check her sharpness (DOF) at full size.

shots.beat: The clockmaker opens his door before Kai knocks: "You're late."
shots.characters: Oskar Hensel (78, clockmaker) in his doorway, Kai (foreground shoulder)
shots.lighting: Rain on the old quarter, warm shop light from inside the door.
shots.notes: The mission stages this scene itself after the knock; the path holds its close shot a little longer.

preview.note: Hensel in his doorway, warm shop light, Kai's shoulder.
